messages:
sam_sales: FYI customer 'Eclipse Systems' submitted a private on‑prem request. Sales asked for feasibility + timeline. Key asks: VPC peering, HSM-backed KMS, airgapped inference, 3-node HA with GPUs, no external egress. Can someone triage?

maria_prod: @sam_sales thanks — low ceremony ask: we need must-have vs nice-to-have, launch acceptance criteria, and any compliance docs. Do we have their SOC/infosec questionnaire?

sam_sales: Uploaded their security questionnaire to the support ticket (link). Quick summary from sales: MUST = HSM, airgap, HA; NICE = 90d logs retention, extra telemetry. Target timeline they asked for: ~6 months.

eli_sre: heads-up: airgap + HSM on customer premises adds install & validation work. Biggest blockers I see: vendor HSM firmware validation, image signing/offline updates, and on-site install windows for rack & network. Rough high-level ETA: 12–20 weeks depending on approvals.

jun_research: From a runtime perspective they want to serve 33B models. We should recommend a quantized profile + Redwood Optimize tuning. Also need to know target GPU type (A100 vs H100) — perf and mem change the architecture.

olivia_success: We'll need an onboarding playbook, runbooks for airgapped upgrades, and a support SLA discussion. Clarify: do they expect 24/7 on‑call from Redwood or managed support?

maria_prod: I'll convert this into a product intake checklist. Can one of you draft acceptance criteria (concise) so I can attach to the ticket and set priority?

eli_sre: Draft acceptance criteria pasted below:
```
- Private control plane reachable via customer VPC or on‑prem connectivity (no public control plane traffic)
- KMS integrated with customer HSM; keys generated and stored in HSM, keys never exported
- No external egress for inference payloads or telemetry unless explicitly whitelisted
- Verified image signing and offline upgrade/rollback path for runtime and models
- HA: 3 active nodes for model serving with rolling upgrade support
- Performance: latency and throughput documented and within SLO for defined load
```

jun_research: Add one more perf acceptance item: model perf regression <= 5% vs our hosted baseline for the chosen quantization profile. Also request a cost/perf estimate for 33B at expected QPS.

maria_prod: Paraphrase summary: Must-have = HSM/KMS, airgap, HA, verified images, perf SLA. Nice-to-have = long retention, SIEM export, optional dedicated monitoring. Any blockers to adding to backlog? :thumbsup:

sam_sales: Sales needs a short feasibility note for the customer by EOD Friday — bullets on scope, timeline ranges, and major risks. Can we get that?

eli_sre: I'll produce a risk list + timeline ranges today. Risk highlights: HSM vendor approval + procurement lead times, customer network segmentation constraints, image signing certificate exchange, on-site install windows, and operator availability for initial cutover. Timeline ranges: best-case 8 weeks, probable 12–16 weeks, worst-case 24+ weeks.

maria_prod: Perfect. I'll create the product ticket and assign priority for roadmap triage. @olivia_success can you prep onboarding checklist and a kickoff agenda template? We'll slot this into tomorrow's customer intake sync.

deploy-bot: New ticket created PROD-1827 private-onprem-eclipse intake (assigned to maria_prod).

olivia_success: On it — drafting runbook + onboarding slides now. Ping me the customer contact and compliance artifacts and I’ll prepare the kickoff invite.
